underwater-barn.x: An underwater barn is a building that can be constructed on the player's underwater farm for housing [[shelluck|Shelluck]]s, [[inkhog|Inkhog]]s, [[carapoultry|Carapoultry]]s, [[seashroud|Seashroud]]s, and [[mermoo|Mermoo]]s.
Although a [[temperature-machine|Temperature machine]] can be placed in the [[underwater-barn|underwater barn]], it's necessity or effectiveness are questionable.
An underwater barn can be bought from the [[underwater-ranch|Underwater Ranch]] for:

An underwater barn takes two days to build and can hold four [[farm-animal|underwater animals]]. The barn must be completed before underwater animals can be purchased from the Underwater Ranch. If the player has donated to the required [[orchestra-sites|Orchestra sites]], and can be moved or destroyed by selecting the Edit Farm Buildings at the [[underwater-ranch|Underwater Ranch]].

stable.x: A stable is a building that can be constructed on the player's [[farm|farm]] for housing a [[horse|horse]].
A stable can be bought from the [[carpenter|Carpenter]]:

A stable takes two days to build and can only contain one animal. Once completed, a stable allows the purchase of a horse from the [[ranch|Ranch]], and can be moved or destroyed by selecting the Edit Farm Buildings option at the [[carpenter|carpenter]]. There are no upgrades for the stable.

mill.x: A mill is a building that can be constructed on the player's [[farm|farm]] for producing sugar, salt and flours.
A mill can be bought from the [[carpenter|Carpenter]]:

A mill takes two days to build. Once completed, a mill can be stocked with grains, sugar, or salt for processing, and can be moved or destroyed by selecting the Edit Farm Buildings option at the [[carpenter|carpenter]]. There are no upgrades for the mill.
Once constructed, a mill can be used to produce sugar, salt and flours.

coop.x: Coop is a building that can be constructed on the player's [[farm|farm]] for housing [[chicken|chicken]]s, [[duck|duck]]s, [[quail|quail]], [[peafowl|peafowl]], and [[ostrich|ostriches]].
A coop can be bought from the [[carpenter|Carpenter]]:

A coop takes two days to build, and can initially hold 4 animals. It takes up a 7x4 space on the player's farm. Once completed, a coop allows the purchase of chickens and ducks from the [[ranch|Ranch]] if the player has also reached the required [[town-rank|town rank]], and can be upgraded, moved, or destroyed by selecting the Edit Farm Buildings at the [[carpenter|carpenter]].

Upgraded coops expand the types of animals the player is able to purchase as well as the number of animals that can be house inside. All coops occupy an 7x4 space on the farm regardless of their upgrade level.
If the player has an existing coop on their farm, they have the option to upgrade that coop for an additional cost of:

The upgrade takes two days to complete, and expands the coop to hold up to 8 animals. A completed level 2 coop also allows the purchase quail from the ranch if the player has also reached the required town rank. Up to 4 peafowl are also available to purchase for a level 2 coop once the required town rank is reached. Up to [quantity] ostriches are available to purchase from Lady Lavanna in the Savannah once the player has completed all Lake Temple altars and unlocked the [[guardian-mural|Guardian Mural]] Altars.
If the player has an existing level 2 coop on their farm, they have the option to upgrade that coop for an additional cost of:
The upgrade will take three days to complete, and will further expand the coop to hold up to 12 animals.

barn.x: A barn is a building that can be constructed on the player's [[farm|farm]] for housing [[cow|cow]]s, [[sheep|sheep]], [[goat|goat]]s, [[pig|pig]]s, [[llama|llama]]s, [[luwak|luwak]]s and [[buffalo|buffalo]].
A barn can be bought from the [[carpenter|Carpenter]] for:

A barn takes two days to build, and can initially hold 4 animals. Once completed, a barn allows the purchase of cows and sheep from the [[ranch|Ranch]] if the player has also reached the required [[town-rank|town rank]], and can be upgraded, moved, or destroyed by selecting the Edit Farm Buildings at the [[carpenter|carpenter]].

Upgraded barns expand the types of animals the player is able to purchase as well as the number of animals that can be house inside. All barns occupy an 8x5 space on the farm regardless of their upgrade level.
If the player has an existing barn on their farm, they have the option to upgrade that barn for an additional cost of:

The upgrade takes two days to complete, and expands the barn to hold up to 8 animals. A completed level 2 barn also allows the purchase of pigs and goats from the ranch if the player has also reached the required town rank. Luwaks and llamas will also be available to purchase for a level 2 barn once they are available in-game.
If the player has an existing level 2 barn on their farm, they have the option to upgrade that barn for an additional cost of:

The upgrade will take three days to complete, and will further expand the barn to hold up to 12 animals. The Level 3 Barn allows [[pig|Pigs]] and [[luwak|Luwaks]] to produce items indoors (allowing them to continue producing in Winter).

silo.x: A silo is a building that can be constructed on the player's [[farm|farm]] for storing [[hay|hay]].
A silo can be bought from the [[carpenter|Carpenter]] for:
Once purchased, the player will select where to place it on their farm in an empty 3x3 space.

A silo takes two days to build. Once completed, a silo will store hay the player places in it for use by [[coop|coop]]s and [[barn|barn]]s, and can be moved or destroyed by selecting the Edit Farm Buildings option at the [[carpenter|carpenter]]. There are no upgrades for the silo.
If you edit the look of the silo or move it to a different place, take your hay out first, because it will all be gone afterwards.

A single silo can store up to 300 pieces of hay, allowing an additional 300 storage for every silo built. Hay can be added to a silo by manually placing hay from the player's inventory in it by interacting with it.

Hay stored in a silo can be taken out using the hoppers found in [[coop|coop]]s and [[barn|barn]]s for feeding [[farm-animal|animals]]. With the [[auto-feeder|Auto Feeder]] placed in the coop or barn, animals' troughs will be automatically filled every day using hay from the player's silos.

fish-pond.x: A fish pond is a building that can be constructed on the player's [[farm|farm]] for breeding [[fish|fish]].
A fish pond blueprint can be bought from the [[carpenter|Carpenter]]:

Once purchased, the blueprint can be selected from the player's inventory and placed on the farm in an empty 5x5 space. The player can purchase multiple blueprints at once and can store them in chests, but they do not stack.

A fish pond takes two days to build. Once completed, a fish pond can be stocked with fish for breeding, and can be moved or destroyed by selecting the Edit Farm Buildings at the [[carpenter|carpenter]]. There are no upgrades for the fish pond.

Once a fish pond has been constructed, the player can place a fish they've caught or found inside of it to breed more fish. Multiple fish of the same type and quality can be placed within the fishpond. The bred fish will be of the same type and quality level as the one placed in the pond. Up to a total of 10 fish, including the original, can be contained in a single pond, at which point breeding will stop until fish are removed.

The rate at which fish breed depends on the rarity of the fish placed. Non legendary fish will spawn every two days, but [[legendary-fish-group|legendary fish]] take twice as long, spawning only every four days. Fish won't breed if there are different species inside the fish pond.
Breeding fish will earn experience points towards [[fishing|fishing]].

insect-house.x: An insect house is a building that can be constructed on the player's [[farm|farm]] for breeding [[insect|insects]].
When player achieve [[catching|catching]] level 8, [[eleanor|Eleanor]] will send player 1 insect house through mail.
A insect house blueprint can be bought from the [[carpenter|Carpenter]] from [[town-rank|rank]] F for:

Once purchased, the blueprint can be selected from the player's inventory and placed on the farm in an empty 5x5 space. The player can purchase multiple blueprints at once and can store them in chests, but they do not stack.

An insect house takes two days to build. Once completed, an insect house can be stocked with insects for breeding, and can be moved or destroyed by selecting the Edit Farm Buildings at the [[carpenter|carpenter]]. There are no upgrades for the insect house.

Once an insect house has been constructed, the player can place an insect they've caught or found inside of it to breed more insects. The bred insects will be of the same type and quality level as the one placed in the house. Up to a total of 10 insects, including the original, can be contained in a single house, at which point breeding will stop until insects are removed.

The rate at which insects breed depends on the rarity of the insect placed. Non legendary insects will spawn every 2 days, but [[legendary-insect-group|legendary insects]] take twice as long, spawning only every 4 days. Insect won't breed if there are different species inside the insect house.
Breeding insects will earn experience points towards [[catching|catching]].

well.x: A well is a building that can be constructed on the player's [[farm|farm]]. It can be used to refill their [[watering-can|watering can]].
A well can be bought from the [[carpenter|Carpenter]] for:

A well takes two days to build. Once completed, a well allows the player to refill their watering can from wherever the well is placed, and can be moved or destroyed by selecting the "Edit Farm Buildings" option at the [[carpenter|carpenter]].
There are no upgrades for the well.

shed.x: A Shed is a building that can be constructed on the player's [[farm|farm]], allowing players a room inside to decorate however they'd like with. The shed provides an interior area of 17x17 and takes two days to be built. The wall and the the floor also can be decorated just like the player's house.
The following artisan machines process twice as fast inside the Shed.
A Shed can be bought from the [[carpenter|Carpenter]]
